review_locator: PMCID:PMC4618768, Control of autoimmune CNS inflammation by astrocytes
primary_title: Astrocytes are the major intracerebral source of macrophage inflammatory protein-3alpha/CCL20 in relapsing experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis and in vitro
decision_basis: The review identifies TNF-alpha as a potent inducer of astrocyte CCL20; the cited primary demonstrates TNF-alpha-dependent CCL20 mRNA induction in mouse brain-derived astrocytes and identifies astrocytes as a major CCL20 source during relapsing EAE.
limitations_preserved: Direct astrocyte CCL20 transcription bridge; preserve mouse/EAE and in-vitro context, distinguish CCL20 gene from secreted chemokine, and do not infer traumatic-SCI weighting.
